newsitem.title: USA: D.R. Horton completes Torrey purchase.
newsitem.headline: D.R. Horton completes Torrey purchase.

text.p: D.R. Horton Inc said Thursday it had completed the acquisition of the stock of the Torrey Group of Cos for about $127 million in cash, stock and debt assumption.
The company, which builds and sells homes, said it paid $28.5 million in cash, $9.5 million in new shares of its common stock and about $89.0 million in assumed debt.

Torrey Homes builds and sells single-family homes for entry-level and first-time buyers with operations in Atlanta, Georgia, Charlotte and Raleigh/Durham, North Carolina, and Greenville, South Carolina.
